# ARL

> ARL is the native utility token planned for decentralized AI and compute services. It is not
> yet deployed: no ARL contract exists on any network, nothing is for sale, and nothing on
> arlcoin.io is an offer, investment advice or a promise of listing.

Key facts:

- Maximum supply: 21,000,000 ARL, minted once at deployment into 11 allocations. The token
  contract has no owner, no mint function after deployment, no pause and no upgrade path.
- Standard: ERC-20 with EIP-2612 permit, 18 decimals, for EVM-compatible chains. The
  deployment chain has not been selected.
- Planned uses: AI services paid per use in ARL, GPU and CPU compute paid per second,
  zero-knowledge anonymous signals, and staking funded from existing allocations, never from
  new issuance.
- Security: internal review complete (unit, fuzz and invariant tests, static analysis,
  symbolic checks). No external audit has been performed. Treasury actions pass a Safe
  multisig and a 48-hour timelock.
- Roadmap: foundation and token contracts complete, security review in progress, testnet and
  mainnet not started. No dates are set.
- ARL never asks for a private key, a seed phrase or a payment.
